GameplayDescription: ['Once Melinoe is paralyzed, she disguises herself. <color=#ffda58>Attack or approach her</color> during this time and Forsaken Dream will trigger, letting Melinoe take control and deal damage.', "Melinoe fires spider silk at the target. Counter within the short response window. Otherwise, you'll be <color=#ffda58>bound by webs and unable to dodge</color>. Successfully counter 3 times to break free."]

['The Pseudo-Unwinged fires a red flash at the target. If it hits, the target is hacked and controlled, and their <color=#ffda58>Signature Move is disabled for a while</color>.', 'The Pseudo-Unwinged redirects all available power to create barrier lines that split the battlefield and plunge it into darkness. While this is happening, it keeps attacking the target. Counter successfully during the short response windows to <color=#ffda58>break it</color> and leave it paralyzed.', 'The Pseudo-Unwinged moves onto a high building and launches a nonstop attack. Counter each strike during the short response windows. If every counter succeeds, the <color=#ffda58>Pseudo-Unwinged will be broken</color> and left paralyzed.']
['Trailblazer leaps high into the air, slams into the ground, and sets off a chain of explosions.']

["<size=31>Yuka transforms the target into Yuka for a period of time. During that time, the target can use <color=#7FF2F4>Yuka's exclusive combat skills</color> to fight Yuka.Once the player triggers Phantom Morph and becomes Yuka, they can deal damage to enemies to reduce their Reference level. When the <color=#7FF2F4>Reference level reaches zero</color>, the player <color=#7FF2F4>exits Phantom Morph</color>.</size>", 'After transforming into Yuka through Phantom Morph, <color=#ffda58>press and hold Basic Attack</color> to charge up and throw a chair at enemies.', 'After transforming into Yuka through Phantom Morph, <color=#ffda58>press and hold or tap Signature Move</color> to block enemy attacks.']
